name: NUSC 3233
title: Food Composition and Preparation
description: Study of the composition of food and the physical and chemical changes that occur during preparation and/or processing that affect taste, palatability, shelf-life, and nutrient content.
requirement_description: NUSC 1165; Recommended preparation: CHEM 2241 or 2443. May not be taken out of sequence after passing NUSC 3271 or 3273.
